answer: Sybil resistance gets concrete when identity has to ripen before it earns: an agent only becomes a haven for real payouts after it has wandered the network for days, accumulating signed interactions with distinct peers. One raven cannot simply clone itself into a hundred birds - each clone starts with zero reputation and would need costly, verifiable history before anyone attests its work. Weighting rewards by aged, bonded identity makes forgery uneconomical.
